mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have 77-degree weather with partly cloudy skies near Fireman's Park. Please note that the air quality index is at a moderate 54 today. Looking ahead to the night, the temperature will dip to a low of 62 degrees, and no rain is predicted for the overnight hours.

In city news, construction continues on the Hwy M project with traffic shifts starting the week of September 7, and the Military Ridge State Trail paving project is moving forward with an upcoming closure between Lincoln and South Franklin Street from mid-September to mid-November.

There is plenty to do in our area. Today, we have the Dane County Farmer's Market, plus live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking forward, we have Yoga at Insight Wellness on September 7, and a variety of trivia nights starting on September 8.

The Verona Police Department announced on Friday, September 4, 2026, that a 34-year-old Madison resident was arrested for the sexual assault of a child by a school staff member, following an investigation into events that took place in 2019.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Mint Cookie. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:30 PM tonight.
